integrity: The proof and independent arithmetic replay specifications are supplied; the review is not external or independent.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns one specified trace-coordinate plane model over the algebraic closure of F11. It does not classify all models with the same outer Galois groups or determine their projective automorphism groups. The complete singularity assertion uses an exact finite census together with genus-bound saturation.
title: A complete ordinary-multiple-point census for a twelve-degree Galois-point curve
